name: triton
raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "3.9.0"
  # cmake/llvm-info.json
  llvm_commit: b010a18d2b648cab83c83967ff26b8fde11acdc6
  # cmake/amd-llvm-info.json
  amd_llvm_commit: 6bc4aaf6641c56ee104f6200c96a6a571bc77052
  build_number: 0

recipe:
  name: triton
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/triton-lang/triton/releases/download/v${{ version }}/triton-${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 264f9a476ff0ca6616de06f0580dbb51e6e35709b9fc209ef8ed6fa689dd8d8d
    patches:
      - patches/0001-Remove-Werror-that-cause-false-positive-build-failur.patch
      # uncomment if we decide to link dynamically again
      # - patches/0002-Do-not-link-directly-to-LLVM-static-libraries.patch
      - patches/0003-Use-system-PATH-to-find-tools-in-CONDA_PREFIX.patch
      # https://github.com/conda-forge/pytorch-cpu-feedstock/issues/317#issuecomment-2585460619
      - patches/0004-Add-conda-forge-include-dirs-to-list-of-include-dirs.patch
      - patches/0005-Make-test_aot-importable-without-a-GPU-backend.patch
  - url: https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/archive/${{ llvm_commit }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 975ad64f584955a714bddd1a3413db14ba3c8cca8292dc020ab58ac4c09decad
    target_directory: llvm-project
  - url: https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/archive/${{ amd_llvm_commit }}.tar.gz
    sha256: d3b733961dc1b4de40bfd3bed5fd10e417336f54da20d586f5b3b5ff7aca72bf
    target_directory: llvm-project-amd

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}
  skip:
    # No success enabling Windows build as of 3.1.0:
    # https://github.com/conda-forge/triton-feedstock/pull/29#issuecomment-2564371725
    - win
    # TODO: CPU-only support still under development
    - match(cuda_compiler_version, "==None")

outputs:
  - staging:
      name: llvm-build

    build:
      script:
        file: build_llvm
        env:
          AMD_LLVM_COMMIT: ${{ amd_llvm_commit }}

    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ninja
        - cmake
      host:
        - zlib
        - zstd

  # workaround for https://github.com/conda-forge/conda-smithy/issues/2673
  - package:
      name: triton-dummy

    build:
      # a hack to make sure this is only present while rerendering
      skip: env.get("CONDA_BLD_PATH") != ""

    inherit: llvm-build

  - package:
      name: triton

    inherit: llvm-build

    build:
      script: build
      string: cuda${{ cuda_compiler_version | version_to_buildstring }}py${{ python | version_to_buildstring }}h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}

    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cuda') }}
        - if: linux and aarch64 and cuda_compiler_version != "None"
          then: arm-variant * ${{ arm_variant_type }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ninja
        - cmake
        - if: win
          then: m2-sed
          else: sed
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - python
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
      host:
        - python
        - nanobind
        - pip
        - setuptools
        - zlib
        - zstd  # for llvm
        - nlohmann_json
        - cuda-cupti-dev
        - cuda-version ${{ cuda_compiler_version }}.*
      run:
        - python
        - setuptools
        - cuda-nvcc-tools
        - cuda-cuobjdump
        - cuda-cudart
        - cuda-cupti

    tests:
      - package_contents:
          bin:
            exists:
              - proton
              - proton-viewer
            not_exists:
              # make sure we don't accidentally install any LLVM files
              - clang
              - lld
              - llvm-as
              - mlir-opt
          files:
            not_exists:
              - include/**
              - lib/lib*
      - python:
          imports:
            - triton
            - triton._C.libtriton
          pip_check: true
      - files:
          source:
            - python/test/
        requirements:
          run:
            - pip
            - pytest
            - scipy
            # use cpu* variant to avoid the pin on specific triton version
            # (also we're doing non-GPU testing)
            - pytorch * cpu*
        script:
          - proton --help
          # requires unpackaged 'llnl-hatchet' (also pandas)
          # - proton-viewer
          # test suite essentially depends on availability of a physical GPU,
          # see https://github.com/triton-lang/triton/issues/466;
          # run a test that does not require a GPU but checks
          # if triton.compile() works
          - TRITON_INTERPRET=1 pytest -v python/test/unit/tools/test_aot.py::test_ttgir_to_asm

about:
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Development repository for the Triton language and compiler
  description: |
    This is the development repository of Triton, a language and compiler for writing highly efficient custom Deep-Learning primitives.
    The aim of Triton is to provide an open-source environment to write fast code at higher productivity than CUDA, but also with higher flexibility than other existing DSLs.
  homepage: https://github.com/triton-lang/triton
  repository: https://github.com/triton-lang/triton
  documentation: https://triton-lang.org/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - h-vetinari
    - mgorny
